findings.title: Restore swapped lightness values for gap link color
Restore inverted lightness for mobile custom-message-length
Preserve original 30% lightness for user-card name
Preserve original 20% lightness for mobile topic-map h3

response:
## 1) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Restore swapped lightness values for gap link color

Affected:
- app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:291

Explanation:
The original light-theme value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new code changes the light branch to 70% and the dark branch to 30%, which swaps the two values.

- On light themes, these bold links become much lighter than before, so contrast drops and the look changes. This was not the intent of the commit.
- On dark themes, the link gets the opposite of the intended emphasis.

Every other line in this change keeps the original primary percentage and uses `100 - X` for the secondary.

Proposed fix:
~~~scss
color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%));
~~~

## 2) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Title: Restore inverted lightness for mobile custom-message-length

Affected:
- app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss:102

Explanation:
The original value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, a muted hint color. The new code uses 30% for primary and 70% for secondary. This is inverted:

- On light themes, the hint becomes dark and prominent instead of muted.
- On dark themes, it becomes bright instead of muted.

It also differs from the desktop version of the same rule in `desktop/modal.scss:94`, which uses 70%/30%.

Proposed fix:
~~~scss
color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%));
~~~

## 3) Severity: LOW | Type: Bug
Title: Preserve original 30% lightness for user-card name

Affected:
- app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss:522
- app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss:497

Explanation:
The original value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new code uses 50%/50%. That lightens the name on light themes and makes it the same color as the adjacent `.title`, which is also 50%. As a result, the name and title can no longer be told apart visually. This change only meant to add dark-theme support and should not have altered the light-theme rendering.

Proposed fix:
~~~scss
color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%));
~~~

## 4) Severity: LOW | Type: Bug
Title: Preserve original 20% lightness for mobile topic-map h3

Affected:
- app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:182

Explanation:
The original value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The new code uses 50%/50%. This changes the light-theme heading color and makes it the same as the `h4` below it. It also differs from the desktop version in `desktop/topic-post.scss:321`, which uses 20%/80%.

Proposed fix:
~~~scss
color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%));
~~~
